verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer mobile app that generates one-time codes. It has no developer API surface, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers only end-user features (sync, QR transfer, code editing) and open-source TOTP/HOTP and PAM implementations, none of which is an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
